abstract: * DOI:10.1016/j.tiv.2017.07.009. # The vitamin B6 paradox: Supplementation with high concentrations of pyridoxine leads to decreased vitamin B6 function. title={The vitamin B6 paradox: Supplementation with high concentrations of pyridoxine leads to decreased vitamin B6 function.},. author={Misha F Vrolijk and Antoon Opperhuizen and Eug{\`e}ne H.J.M. Jansen and Geja Hageman and Aalt Bast and Guido Haenen},. High plasma levels of PM after oral PM supplementation are shown and the B6 vitamer PM is an interesting supplement as an inhibitor of harmful processes in metabolic diseases and for the treatment of vitamin B6 deficiency. ### Vitamin B-6-Induced Neuropathy: Exploring the Mechanisms of Pyridoxine Toxicity. Low plasma PLP during inflammation may reflect impaired cellular vitamin B-6 status, as indicated by the concurrent increase in plasma HK, and Oral supplementation with pyridoxine hydrochloride reduced the geometric mean of HK from 29.5 to 20.2 nmol/L (P < 0.001), and abolished the steep segment of the PLP-HK curve. ### Direct and Functional Biomarkers of Vitamin B6 Status.
